narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to Warren County in New Jersey on the night of September 8. Rainfall totals were as high as 2 to 5 inches.
ev: A section of US Route 46 in Knowlton Township was closed due to flooding. Also, a bridge was washed out on Knowlton Road.
lsr: FLOODING ON US 46 IN BOTH DIRECTIONS IN THE AREA OF NJ 163. ALL LANES CLOSED. TIME BASED ON DISPATCH REPORT.
